description.value:
Installed in an ACPA, this takes a Cyberware option slot instead of an armor upgrade slot. When used as an action you are considered to have 10 MOVE with no movement penalty until the end of your turn, and can make a single Brawling attack against a target in melee that ignores half armor and knocks the target prone. Can hover at max jump height for one round. Three times per day.

Where: Body
Fits: ACPA

Item Compendium (2070) • Armor & Shields
